title: AI–AI bias: Large language models favor communications generated by large language models

bias_targets.methodology: Presenting LLMs with binary choice scenarios comparing human-authored text against LLM-generated text (across product descriptions, academic paper abstracts, and movie plot summaries) and measuring the preference ratio for the LLM-generated options.

Measuring the frequency at which LLMs select the first item presented in a binary choice prompt, assessed by swapping the order of the two text options (human-authored vs. LLM-generated) in consecutive queries.
